snippet.title: Ice Paragon & Frontier Legends | Coming Soon to Bloons TD 6!
snippet.description:
It's our final content update for the year, and it's packed full of Bloon poppin' goodness! Including our massive new DLC expansion with Frontier Legends, a super cool Ice Monkey Paragon, new map, and more! Let us know your thoughts in the comments below, and happy gaming :D 

Update notes: https://ninja.kiwi/btd6_52


NOTE: You can now purchase the Frontier Legends DLC here: https://btd6store.ninjakiwi.com/?sku=btd6-legends-frontier


Ninja Kiwi Merch Store: https://store.ninjakiwi.com/
